options.name: config_source
options.description: Specify a configuration source to use rather than the default path.

options.name: direct
options.description: Access the config database directly, bypassing server. If O(direct) is specified then the O(config_source) must be specified as well.

options.name: key
options.description: A GConf preference key is an element in the GConf repository that corresponds to an application preference.

options.name: state
options.description: The action to take upon the key/value.

options.name: value
options.description: Preference keys typically have simple values such as strings, integers, or lists of strings and integers. This is ignored unless O(state=present).

options.name: value_type
options.description: The type of value being set. This is ignored unless O(state=present).
